linux: set -eu; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl; digest=bc2b8902b0d9c796c82ef45f16ae2307e17757afeca5ee156235a3dc7bda5f89;; arm64|aarch64) target=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu; digest=d1cc49dfa2cd443fc32625444b59fe616b6c80478cca210985118347174dd758;; *) printf "Unsupported RTK architecture\n" >&2; exit 1;; esac; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases/download/v0.50.0/rtk-${target}.tar.gz" -o "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz"; printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" rtk; install_dir=${RTK_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}; mkdir -p "$install_dir"; install -m 755 "$tmp/rtk" "$install_dir/rtk"

set -eu; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl; digest=bc2b8902b0d9c796c82ef45f16ae2307e17757afeca5ee156235a3dc7bda5f89;; arm64|aarch64) target=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu; digest=d1cc49dfa2cd443fc32625444b59fe616b6c80478cca210985118347174dd758;; *) printf "Unsupported RTK architecture\n" >&2; exit 1;; esac; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases/download/v{version}/rtk-${target}.tar.gz" -o "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz"; printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" rtk; install_dir=${RTK_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}; mkdir -p "$install_dir"; install -m 755 "$tmp/rtk" "$install_dir/rtk"

current=$(rtk --version 2>/dev/null || true); current=${current#rtk }; if [ -n "$current" ] && [ "$(printf '%s
' '0.50.0' "$current" | sort -V | sed -n '1p')" = '0.50.0' ]; then printf 'RTK %s is already at least 0.50.0
' "$current"; else set -eu; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl; digest=bc2b8902b0d9c796c82ef45f16ae2307e17757afeca5ee156235a3dc7bda5f89;; arm64|aarch64) target=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu; digest=d1cc49dfa2cd443fc32625444b59fe616b6c80478cca210985118347174dd758;; *) printf "Unsupported RTK architecture
" >&2; exit 1;; esac; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases/download/v0.50.0/rtk-${target}.tar.gz" -o "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz"; printf '%s  %s
' "$digest" "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" rtk; install_dir=${RTK_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}; mkdir -p "$install_dir"; install -m 755 "$tmp/rtk" "$install_dir/rtk"; fi
